name: City council Flock camera accountability mapper

mentions.name: City council Flock camera accountability mapper
mentions.description: This web tool maps city councils and the Flock surveillance cameras in their districts, covering about 1,000 councils so far, and enables one-click petitions to remove or replace the accountable council member. It is being readied ahead of the November 3 midterm elections.
mentions.problem: City councils face little accountability for Flock surveillance cameras installed in their districts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am making a way to hold city councils accountable for flock cameras in their district.

I have 1k councils so far, mapping shit now so you can in 1 click petition to remove or replace the council member.
